package.name: nros_board_fvp_aemv8r_smp
package.description:
Arm Fast Models AEMv8-R FVP board support for nano-ros — Zephyr on `fvp_baser_aemv8r/fvp_aemv8r_aarch64/smp`, Cortex-A AArch64 SMP.
This package is a CONFIG BUNDLE: prj.conf, a per-board Kconfig fragment, a DTS overlay, a west manifest fragment and a Kconfig module, with no Rust of its own. phase-337 W9.a folded the former `nros-board-fvp-aemv8r-smp` crate into this directory after measuring that its Rust half had zero consumers.
phase-215.K.2 — this file exists so the provider is DISCOVERABLE. Until RFC-0064 R5 the board announced nothing and had no descriptor: it resolved only as an ALIAS on the `zephyr` board, attached by a walk that read its `board.cmake`. That file is gone, so the announcement is now the only thing that makes this board a board.
